question: Satyajit Ray was honoured with Bharat Ratna in 1992. He was a famous ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Filmmaker.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyajit Ray **was a **famous filmmaker** and is considered one of the greatest directors in the history of Indian cinema. 
 
• He was known for his **realistic and socially relevant films** that depicted the lives of ordinary people.
 
• Ray was also a **writer, composer, and graphic designer**, and his contributions to Indian cinema have been widely recognized.
 
• He won numerous awards for his films, including the** Golden Lion **at the **Venice Film Festival**, and was honoured with the** Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **1992.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Physicist:** A physicist is a scientist who studies the** properties and behavior of matter and energy**. 
 
• **Cricketer**: A cricketer is a player of the game of cricket.
 
• **Lawyer:** A lawyer is a professional who practices** law, as an advocate, barrister, attorney, counselor, solicitor, notary, or civil law notary**.
